name: MusicBrainz Album Subset (10k Releases)
description: Subset of the MusicBrainz dataset covering more than 10,000 different albums (releases). Releases are described by attributes such as title, artist, release date, release country, and the list of tracks contained on the album. Some attribute values are missing or incorrect. The dataset is provided as XML and uses the MusicBrainz MMD 2.0 namespace.

variableMeasured.name: metadata@xmlns
variableMeasured.description: XML namespace used in the document (MMD 2.0 namespace).

variableMeasured.name: release@id
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID) for the release (UUID in the release element's id attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/title
variableMeasured.description: Title of the release.

variableMeasured.name: release/rel_id
variableMeasured.description: Internal dataset identifier for the release record (e.g., 'mbrainz_1').

variableMeasured.name: release/status
variableMeasured.description: Release status text (e.g., 'Official').

variableMeasured.name: release/status@id
variableMeasured.description: Identifier attribute for the release status element when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/quality
variableMeasured.description: Quality value for the release record (e.g., 'normal', 'high').

variableMeasured.name: release/artist
variableMeasured.description: Artist name as provided in the dataset for the release.

variableMeasured.name: release/date
variableMeasured.description: Release date value as provided in the dataset. Example values include a year only (e.g., '1996') or a full date (e.g., '1998-12-14').

variableMeasured.name: release/country
variableMeasured.description: Release country code as provided in the dataset (e.g., 'GB', 'US').

variableMeasured.name: release/barcode
variableMeasured.description: Barcode value for the release when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/asin
variableMeasured.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) for the release when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/packaging
variableMeasured.description: Packaging description for the release when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/packaging@id
variableMeasured.description: Identifier attribute for the packaging element when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list@count
variableMeasured.description: Number of media items listed for the release (from medium-list count attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/position
variableMeasured.description: Medium position number within the release (e.g., disc 1).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/title
variableMeasured.description: Medium title when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/format
variableMeasured.description: Medium format text (e.g., '12" Vinyl', 'CD').

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/format@id
variableMeasured.description: Identifier attribute for the medium format element when present.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list@count
variableMeasured.description: Number of tracks listed for the medium (from track-list count attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list@offset
variableMeasured.description: Offset attribute for the track-list element when present (seen as '0' in examples).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track@id
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID) for the track entry (UUID in the track element's id attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/position
variableMeasured.description: Track position number within the medium.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/number
variableMeasured.description: Track number as printed on the release (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'A1', '1').

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/length
variableMeasured.description: Track length value when present (numeric values in examples).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording@id
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID) for the recording associated with the track (UUID in the recording element's id attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/title
variableMeasured.description: Recording title associated with the track.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/length
variableMeasured.description: Recording length value when present (numeric values in examples).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/artist-credit/name-credit/artist@id
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID) for an artist credited on the recording (UUID in the artist element's id attribute).

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/artist-credit/name-credit/artist/name
variableMeasured.description: Credited artist name for the recording.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/artist-credit/name-credit/artist/sort-name
variableMeasured.description: Artist sort name for the credited artist.

variableMeasured.name: release/medium-list/medium/track-list/track/recording/artist-credit/name-credit/artist/disambiguation
variableMeasured.description: Artist disambiguation text when present.
